Name: Ultimate Bed Customization
Author: oddandevander
Description:
[font=Courier New][size=5][b]Stardew Valley Ultimate Bed Customization Mod
[/b][/size]
[b][size=4]What This Mod Does

[/size][/b][/font]This mod allows you to customize the bedding in Stardew Valley (using the default single and double beds, as well as the children's bed). [font=Courier New][b][size=4]
[/size][/b]
[size=4][b]How to Configure Mod[/b]
[/size]
To customize this mod, change the values in the [b]config.json[/b] file to any of the accepted values. You can also use the [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url], which I would recommend. The mod also contains a folder of reference images with images and names.

Here is a list of accepted configuration values:
[/font][list]
[*][font=Courier New][u][b]All Sheets:[/b][/u] BabyBlue, BabyPink, Black, Blue, Brown, Cream, DarkGray, Gray, Green, Lavender, Midnight, Mint, Orange, Peach, Pink, Plum, Purple, Red, Salmon, Sky, Vanilla, White, Yellow[/font]
[*][font=Courier New][b][u]All Pillows:[/u][/b] BabyBlue, BabyPink, Basic, Black, Blue, Brown, Cream, DarkGray, Gold, Gray, Green, Lavender, Magenta, Midnight, Mint, Orange, Peach, Pink, Plum, Red, Teal, White, Yellow, BasicBlack, BasicBlue, BasicGreen, BasicPurple, Birch, BlueSky, Exotic, Fisher, Vanilla, VanillaDouble, WhiteBlack, WhitePurple, Wild[/font]
[*][font=Courier New][b][u]All Blankets:[/u][/b] BabyBlue, BabyPink, Black, Blue, Cream, DarkGray, Gold, Gray, Green, Lavender, LightBlue, Magenta, Midnight, Mint, Orange, Peach, Pink, Plum, Red, Teal, Vanilla, White, Yellow, BlackStarry, BlueFlower, BluePlaid, BlueRetro, Fish, Forest, GreenPlaid, GreenRetro, Joja, PinkFlower, Pirate, PurplePattern, PurpleRetro, RedPattern, Sky, Starry, Strawberry[/font]
[*][font=Courier New][b][u]All Frames:[/u][/b] Amethyst, Aquamarine, Birch, Black, BlueWood, Brown, Chocolate, Yellow, Gray, PinkWood, Purple, Seafoam, Swamp, Vanilla, White, Wine[/font]
[/list][font=Courier New]
[b]All the children beds will be the same![/b] My mod only "replaces" the original sprites, which only contain one child bed, thus I currently have no way to make the children beds have separate textures. If anyone else has the skill to implement this they can feel free! Sorry!

[b][size=3]Author's Notes[/size]
[/b]
[u]THIS MOD WAS MADE WITH THE HELP OF [/u][u][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/54167332]XIDDAV[/url]'S [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5368]MAKE YOUR BED[/url] MOD.
[/u]Some of the customization options (sheets, pillows, and blankets) from their mod are present in this mod as well, while others have been removed.

This was my first time modding Stardew Valley and I used xiddav's mod in order to understand how the code works and how to write it. While most of the assets currently used by this mod are made by me, some of them were taken from the Make Your Bed mod and belong to xiddav. ﻿I will remove them if requested, but for now I left many of them in for additional customization options.

I will likely continue to update this mod for now, so please feel free to report any bugs or suggestions![/font]
